# eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets (Data Source)

Retrieves the S3 buckets available in an AWS restore account. Use this data source to select a destination bucket for `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_account_aws_s3_buckets" "destination" {
  restore_account_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the AWS restore account.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of S3 buckets available in the restore account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket.
- `region_name` (String) AWS Region where the S3 bucket is located.
